title: identical style
meaning_vi: phong cách giống hệt nhau

examples.en: Requiring every house to follow an identical style can make neighbourhoods feel monotonous.

title: overall appearance and function
meaning_vi: hình thức và công năng tổng thể

examples.en: Poor maintenance can damage the overall appearance and function of public spaces.

title: pinnacle
meaning_vi: đỉnh cao

examples.en: Gothic cathedrals represent the pinnacle of medieval architectural achievement.

title: bring the area a sense of uniformity
term: bring the area a sense of uniformity
pronunciation: /brɪŋ ði ˈeəriə ə sens əv ˌjuːnɪˈfɔːməti/
meaning_vi: mang lại cho khu vực sự đồng nhất

examples.en: Consistent building codes bring the area a sense of uniformity.

title: individual liberties
meaning_vi: quyền tự do cá nhân

examples.en: Restricting house design too strictly can infringe on individual liberties.

title: occupy prime urban land
meaning_vi: chiếm giữ đất đô thị đắc địa

examples.en: Derelict warehouses that occupy prime urban land could instead be redeveloped into affordable housing.

title: fast-growing metropolitan areas
meaning_vi: khu vực đô thị phát triển nhanh

examples.en: Fast-growing metropolitan areas often struggle to balance heritage conservation with modern infrastructure needs.

title: densely populated cities
meaning_vi: các thành phố đông dân

examples.en: High-rise apartments are essential in densely populated cities like Hong Kong.

title: availability
meaning_vi: tính sẵn có

examples.en: The availability of land often determines whether cities build upward or outward.

title: single-storey house
meaning_vi: nhà một tầng

examples.en: A single-storey house may not suit a large family with limited land.

title: vertical housing
meaning_vi: nhà ở theo chiều dọc (chung cư cao tầng)

examples.en: Vertical housing is often the only practical solution in densely populated cities.

title: horizontal housing
meaning_vi: nhà ở theo chiều ngang (nhà thấp tầng)

examples.en: Horizontal housing offers more privacy but requires far more land than apartments.

title: one-size-fits-all solution
meaning_vi: giải pháp áp dụng chung cho tất cả

examples.en: Housing policy should not rely on a one-size-fits-all solution for every city.

title: pre-furnished
meaning_vi: đã trang bị nội thất sẵn

examples.en: Many modern apartments are sold pre-furnished, saving new residents time and money.

title: urban quality of life
meaning_vi: chất lượng cuộc sống đô thị

examples.en: Well-designed green spaces can dramatically improve urban quality of life for city residents.

title: obstruct urban progress
meaning_vi: cản trở sự phát triển đô thị

examples.en: Some argue that rigid conservation rules obstruct urban progress by preventing necessary redevelopment.

title: restrict city expansion
meaning_vi: hạn chế sự mở rộng thành phố

examples.en: Overly strict preservation zones can restrict city expansion in already crowded metropolitan areas.

title: counterproductive to urban modernization
meaning_vi: phản tác dụng đối với hiện đại hóa đô thị

examples.en: Blanket preservation orders can be counterproductive to urban modernization when they block essential upgrades.

title: obstructing
meaning_vi: (v (gerund)). cản trở, gây trở ngại

examples.en: Outdated zoning rules risk obstructing much-needed urban development.

title: financial burden
meaning_vi: gánh nặng tài chính

examples.en: Rising construction costs have become a heavy financial burden for first-time homeowners.

title: drawbacks
meaning_vi: nhược điểm, hạn chế

examples.en: The drawbacks of high-rise living include noise and a lack of privacy.

title: cause inconveniences
meaning_vi: gây ra bất tiện

examples.en: Strict design regulations can cause inconveniences for growing families.

title: live in discomfort
meaning_vi: sống trong sự bất tiện

examples.en: Forcing families into undersized homes means they must live in discomfort.

title: essential to a child's development
meaning_vi: thiết yếu đối với sự phát triển của trẻ

examples.en: Access to a garden is essential to a child's development, according to many experts.

title: multi-purpose areas
meaning_vi: khu vực đa chức năng

examples.en: City planners often designate multi-purpose areas that can host sports, markets, and community events.

title: mixed-use district
meaning_vi: khu vực đa chức năng (ở, làm việc, giải trí)

examples.en: Converting the old dockyard into a mixed-use district revitalised the surrounding neighbourhood.

title: maximize land usage
meaning_vi: tối đa hóa việc sử dụng đất

examples.en: High-rise developments maximize land usage in cities where space is scarce.

title: open green area
meaning_vi: khu vực xanh mở

examples.en: Reducing open green areas in new developments limits opportunities for community exercise and relaxation.

title: affordable housing
meaning_vi: nhà ở giá cả phải chăng

examples.en: Local authorities must prioritise affordable housing to accommodate the growing urban population.

title: design their houses to their own liking
term: design their houses to their own liking
pronunciation: /dɪˈzaɪn ðeə ˈhaʊzɪz tə ðeər əʊn ˈlaɪkɪŋ/
meaning_vi: thiết kế nhà theo sở thích riêng

examples.en: Homeowners should be free to design their houses to their own liking.

title: tangible evidence
meaning_vi: bằng chứng hữu hình

examples.en: Old temples provide tangible evidence of a nation's architectural heritage.

title: historic edifice
meaning_vi: công trình kiến trúc lịch sử

examples.en: Each historic edifice in the old quarter tells a story of the city's past.

title: heritage landmark
meaning_vi: địa danh di sản

examples.en: The restored cathedral remains one of the city's most cherished heritage landmarks.

title: cultural identity
meaning_vi: bản sắc văn hóa

examples.en: Preserving traditional architecture helps a nation retain its cultural identity amid rapid globalisation.

title: collective memory
meaning_vi: ký ức tập thể

examples.en: Historic buildings act as repositories of a community's collective memory.

title: historical and cultural importance
meaning_vi: tầm quan trọng lịch sử và văn hóa

examples.en: The old market hall holds such historical and cultural importance that its demolition sparked public outcry.

title: cultural heritage
meaning_vi: di sản văn hóa

examples.en: Governments should allocate sufficient funding to protect the nation's cultural heritage.

title: a historical or cultural significance
meaning_vi: ý nghĩa lịch sử hoặc văn hóa

examples.en: Old buildings often carry a historical or cultural significance that modern structures lack.

title: acknowledging
meaning_vi: (v (gerund)). thừa nhận, công nhận

examples.en: While acknowledging the costs involved, I still believe heritage buildings deserve protection.

title: a contentious issue
meaning_vi: một vấn đề gây tranh cãi

examples.en: Whether to demolish old buildings for new development remains a contentious issue.

title: a testament
meaning_vi: một minh chứng

examples.en: The old cathedral stands as a testament to the city's rich history.

title: main attractions
meaning_vi: điểm thu hút chính

examples.en: The old town's narrow streets are among its main attractions for tourists.

title: insufficient to justify the loss
meaning_vi: không đủ để biện minh cho sự mất mát

examples.en: The modest economic gains are insufficient to justify the loss of a historic town square.

title: impede modernization
meaning_vi: cản trở hiện đại hóa

examples.en: Critics argue that strict heritage laws impede modernization in rapidly growing cities.

title: a heritage destination
meaning_vi: điểm đến di sản

examples.en: With its restored ancient quarter, the city has become a popular heritage destination for tourists.

title: boost local economies
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy nền kinh tế địa phương

examples.en: Renovated historic districts can boost local economies by attracting visitors and new businesses.

title: stimulating tourism-based industries
meaning_vi: kích thích các ngành công nghiệp dựa vào du lịch

examples.en: Restoring ancient citadels is an effective way of stimulating tourism-based industries in rural provinces.

title: excessive spending on deteriorating monuments
meaning_vi: chi tiêu quá mức cho các di tích xuống cấp

examples.en: Excessive spending on deteriorating monuments has sparked debate over budget priorities in the capital.

title: generate economic benefits
meaning_vi: tạo ra lợi ích kinh tế

examples.en: Redeveloping the waterfront is expected to generate economic benefits for the whole region.

title: a sense of cultural identity
meaning_vi: cảm giác về bản sắc văn hóa

examples.en: Restored old quarters give residents a sense of cultural identity that new developments often lack.

title: a sense of continuity
meaning_vi: cảm giác về sự tiếp nối

examples.en: Walking through the preserved old town gives visitors a sense of continuity with the past.

title: a sense of pride
meaning_vi: cảm giác tự hào

examples.en: Restoring the ancestral temple instilled a sense of pride among local villagers.

title: boosting tourism
meaning_vi: (v phrase (gerund)). thúc đẩy du lịch

examples.en: Restoring landmark buildings can play a key role in boosting tourism.

title: generating revenue for local businesses
meaning_vi: tạo doanh thu cho doanh nghiệp địa phương

examples.en: Heritage sites attract large numbers of tourists, generating revenue for local businesses.

title: becoming symbols of national heritage
meaning_vi: trở thành biểu tượng của di sản quốc gia

examples.en: Grand monuments often end up becoming symbols of national heritage.

title: come at the cost
meaning_vi: phải trả giá bằng

examples.en: Preserving old buildings can come at the cost of much-needed economic development.

title: ensuring cultural continuity
meaning_vi: đảm bảo tính liên tục văn hóa

examples.en: Preserving traditional architecture plays a key role in ensuring cultural continuity across generations.

title: safeguarded
meaning_vi: được bảo vệ, gìn giữ

examples.en: Ancient temples should be safeguarded through strict conservation laws.

title: demolishing
meaning_vi: phá dỡ

examples.en: Demolishing the old textile mill to build a shopping centre proved highly controversial.

title: renovate
meaning_vi: cải tạo, tu sửa

examples.en: Many cities choose to renovate historic buildings rather than demolish them.

title: maintain a city's character and charm
term: maintain a city's character and charm
meaning_vi: duy trì đặc trưng và nét quyến rũ của thành phố

examples.en: Preserving old streets and facades helps maintain a city's character and charm.

title: offset
meaning_vi: bù đắp, cân bằng lại

examples.en: The cultural value of heritage buildings can offset the financial burden of maintaining them.

title: maintain traditional values
meaning_vi: duy trì các giá trị truyền thống

examples.en: Preserving old architecture helps maintain traditional values within a community.

title: preserve the ancient look
meaning_vi: bảo tồn diện mạo cổ kính

examples.en: Strict building regulations help preserve the ancient look of historic towns.

title: conform to this obligation
meaning_vi: tuân theo nghĩa vụ này

examples.en: Even international chains must conform to this obligation when building in heritage areas.

title: carbon footprint
meaning_vi: dấu chân carbon

examples.en: Retrofitting old buildings rather than demolishing them can substantially reduce a city's carbon footprint.

title: environmental sustainability
meaning_vi: tính bền vững môi trường

examples.en: New building codes now place environmental sustainability at the heart of urban design.

title: economically unsustainable
meaning_vi: không bền vững về mặt kinh tế

examples.en: Constantly demolishing and rebuilding city blocks is economically unsustainable in the long run.

title: mental well-being
meaning_vi: sức khỏe tinh thần

examples.en: Access to green spaces has been shown to improve residents' mental well-being.

title: environmentally responsible behaviour
meaning_vi: hành vi có trách nhiệm với môi trường

examples.en: Green building initiatives encourage environmentally responsible behaviour among residents.

title: environmental stewardship
meaning_vi: sự quản lý và bảo vệ môi trường có trách nhiệm

examples.en: Sustainable architecture reflects a growing commitment to environmental stewardship in city planning.

title: reduce the community's carbon footprint
meaning_vi: giảm lượng khí thải carbon của cộng đồng

examples.en: Installing solar panels on public buildings can significantly reduce the community's carbon footprint.

title: transport arteries
meaning_vi: các tuyến giao thông huyết mạch

examples.en: Expanding the city's transport arteries would help relieve chronic traffic congestion.

title: maintenance
meaning_vi: sự bảo trì, bảo dưỡng

examples.en: Regular maintenance is essential to keep century-old bridges structurally safe.

title: specialized workers
meaning_vi: lao động chuyên môn

examples.en: Large construction projects create demand for specialized workers such as engineers and architects.

title: pressing needs
meaning_vi: nhu cầu cấp bách

examples.en: Governments must balance heritage preservation with more pressing needs like affordable housing.

title: community garden
meaning_vi: vườn cộng đồng

examples.en: A well-run community garden can bring together neighbours who rarely interacted before.

title: passive relaxation
meaning_vi: sự thư giãn thụ động

examples.en: City parks should provide space for both active sports and passive relaxation.

title: face maintenance challenges
meaning_vi: đối mặt với thách thức bảo trì

examples.en: Ageing public buildings often face maintenance challenges that strain municipal budgets.

title: poorly managed
meaning_vi: quản lý kém

examples.en: A poorly managed public housing project can quickly fall into disrepair.

title: strain public finances
meaning_vi: gây áp lực lên tài chính công

examples.en: Restoring dozens of crumbling monuments can strain public finances considerably.

title: consume substantial public funds
meaning_vi: tiêu tốn nguồn ngân sách công đáng kể

examples.en: Restoring century-old landmarks can consume substantial public funds that might otherwise fund schools.

title: substantial expenditure
meaning_vi: chi tiêu đáng kể

examples.en: The government approved substantial expenditure to restore the crumbling opera house.

title: divert
meaning_vi: chuyển hướng (nguồn lực)

examples.en: Spending heavily on restoration may divert funds from more urgent housing needs.

title: hinder
meaning_vi: cản trở

examples.en: Strict preservation laws can hinder the construction of modern infrastructure.

title: economic prosperity
meaning_vi: sự thịnh vượng kinh tế

examples.en: New infrastructure projects are often designed to promote economic prosperity.

title: promotes healthy eating
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy việc ăn uống lành mạnh

examples.en: Urban gardening schemes that promote healthy eating can significantly reduce diet-related illnesses among city dwellers.

title: a degree of self-sufficiency
meaning_vi: một mức độ tự cung tự cấp

examples.en: Growing produce at home gives families a degree of self-sufficiency, reducing their reliance on supermarkets.

title: fresh, nutritious produce
meaning_vi: nông sản tươi, giàu dinh dưỡng

examples.en: Community gardens allow residents to grow fresh, nutritious produce right on their doorstep.

title: nutrient-rich food
meaning_vi: thực phẩm giàu dinh dưỡng

examples.en: Home gardening gives families easy access to nutrient-rich food without added chemicals.

title: shared purpose
meaning_vi: mục đích chung

examples.en: Designing communal courtyards can create a shared purpose among apartment residents.

title: uneven participation
meaning_vi: sự tham gia không đồng đều

examples.en: Community garden schemes often fail because of uneven participation among residents.

title: a sense of community
meaning_vi: cảm giác cộng đồng

examples.en: Shared facilities in apartment complexes can foster a sense of community.

title: allocate their budget
meaning_vi: phân bổ ngân sách

examples.en: City councils must decide how to allocate their budget between new construction and renovation.

title: revitalizing existing public buildings
meaning_vi: (v phrase (gerund)). hồi sinh các công trình công cộng hiện có

examples.en: Revitalizing existing public buildings is often cheaper than constructing new ones from scratch.

title: community allotments for residents
meaning_vi: các mảnh đất công cộng phân bổ cho cư dân để canh tác

examples.en: Providing community allotments for residents can strengthen neighbourhood ties while promoting sustainable food production.

title: foster community engagement
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy sự tham gia của cộng đồng

examples.en: Shared public spaces can foster community engagement by giving neighbours a reason to interact regularly.

title: forge stronger community bonds
meaning_vi: xây dựng mối liên kết cộng đồng chặt chẽ hơn

examples.en: Collaborative building projects can forge stronger community bonds among residents of different backgrounds.

title: maintaining fair, widespread access
meaning_vi: duy trì sự tiếp cận công bằng, rộng rãi

examples.en: Maintaining fair, widespread access to public parks remains a challenge in densely populated cities.

title: convert public parks and open spaces into community gardens
term: convert public parks and open spaces into community gardens
pronunciation: /kənˈvɜːt ˈpʌblɪk pɑːks ənd ˈəʊpən ˈspeɪsɪz ˈɪntuː kəˈmjuːnəti ˈɡɑːdnz/
meaning_vi: chuyển đổi công viên công cộng và không gian mở thành vườn cộng đồng

examples.en: Some councils plan to convert public parks and open spaces into community gardens to boost local food production.

title: enhance the identity and pride of a community
term: enhance the identity and pride of a community
pronunciation: /ɪnˈhɑːns ði aɪˈdentəti ænd praɪd əv ə kəˈmjuːnəti/
meaning_vi: nâng cao bản sắc và niềm tự hào của cộng đồng

examples.en: Iconic public buildings can enhance the identity and pride of a community.

title: strengthening the sense of belonging among its people
term: strengthening the sense of belonging among its people
pronunciation: /ˈstreŋθənɪŋ ðə sens əv bɪˈlɒŋɪŋ əˈmʌŋ ɪts ˈpiːpəl/
meaning_vi: củng cố cảm giác thuộc về của người dân

examples.en: Shared public spaces play a role in strengthening the sense of belonging among its people.

title: incorporate advanced technologies and sustainable design
term: incorporate advanced technologies and sustainable design
meaning_vi: tích hợp công nghệ tiên tiến và thiết kế bền vững

examples.en: Modern office towers increasingly incorporate advanced technologies and sustainable design to cut energy use.
